question: cuántos comercios activos tenemos
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS merchant_count FROM v_merchant_current WHERE is_active = true AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM v_payment_intent WHERE payment_intent_id IN (SELECT payment_intent_id FROM v_attempt_dedup WHERE merchant_sk = v_merchant_current.merchant_sk AND auth_status = 'approved' AND NOT is_test) AND event_date > (SELECT MAX(event_date) FROM fact_payment_attempt) - INTERVAL 30 DAY)
